overview: 计算机视觉研究怎样从图像和视频中提取有用的信息。相册按人物整理、路口统计车辆、医学影像中勾出病灶，都要把像素变成可用的判断。分类回答是什么，检测补上位置，分割细到每个像素；三维视觉还要恢复距离、形状和空间关系。
入门时先选一种输出，再看模型如何得到它。卷积网络用同一组小滤镜在不同位置提取局部特征，视觉 Transformer 则把图像切成小块，让这些块交换信息。结构之外，数据怎样标注、测试图与训练图差多少，也常常决定模型能不能用。
solves: 识别与检索：给图片分类，或从图库里找到相似内容。
定位与测量：找出物体的位置、轮廓，统计数量或估计尺寸。
场景理解：结合连续画面或多个视角，估计运动、深度与三维结构。
zh.stance: 先把一种任务的输入、标注和评价指标讲明白，再比较网络。

roadmap.title: 从手工特征到学习特征
roadmap.text: AlexNet 让卷积网络在大规模图像分类中显示出优势。一起看数据、GPU 训练和模型结构，才能理解这次进展。

roadmap.title: 网络加深，为什么反而难学
roadmap.text: ResNet 用跨层相加的连接改善深层网络的优化。这里的问题是怎样把网络训好，学到的视觉特征也能服务其他任务。

roadmap.title: 另一条任务线：同时识别与定位
roadmap.text: YOLO 直接从整张图预测框和类别，把检测写成一个统一的预测问题。它与分类网络不是前后替代关系。

roadmap.title: 把图像看成一串小块
roadmap.text: ViT 将图像块送入 Transformer，并研究大规模预训练怎样影响效果。卷积与注意力由此成为可以按任务、数据和成本选择的设计。

terms.text: 让一个小滤镜在图像上移动，同一组参数检查不同位置。多层组合后，可以从局部纹理形成更复杂的特征。
模型中间层产生的一组数字，用来保留对任务有用的信息。它可以交给分类器，也可以供检测、检索等任务使用。
Patch 是切下来的图像块；attention 按输入内容决定各块之间交换多少信息。一个块不是天然对应一个物体。
IoU 衡量预测框与真实框的重叠程度；mAP 汇总各类别检测的精确率与召回率关系。比较 mAP 时要对齐重叠阈值和评价协议。

checklist: 做一次 MNIST 预测，把至少 10 张错分图片、真实标签和预测标签排在一起，写出最常见的混淆。
用 YOLO 检测自己的几张照片，保存带框结果；分别找出一次漏检、一次误检和一次框不准。
固定模型，对同一组图做遮挡或改变亮度，比较预测变化；把测试图片与结果一起保留。
zh.paperIntro: 先用 AlexNet 和 ResNet 读懂特征学习与训练，再按兴趣选 YOLO 或 ViT；每篇都对照输入、输出和实验看。

overview: Computer vision extracts useful information from images and video. Organizing photos by person, counting road traffic, and outlining a lesion all turn pixels into decisions. Classification asks what is present, detection adds locations, and segmentation labels pixels. 3D vision also studies distance, shape, and spatial relationships.

Choose an output first, then follow how the model produces it. Convolutional networks reuse small filters across locations; vision Transformers split images into patches and let them exchange information. Architecture is only part of the story: annotation quality and differences between training and test images often determine whether a model is useful.
solves: Recognition and retrieval: classify an image or find similar content in a collection.
Localization and measurement: find positions and outlines, count objects, or estimate size.
Scene understanding: use video or multiple views to estimate motion, depth, and 3D structure.
en.stance: Clarify the input, labels, and evaluation metric before comparing networks.

roadmap.title: Learning visual features
roadmap.text: AlexNet demonstrated the strength of convolutional networks on large-scale image classification. Data, GPU training, and architecture belong in the same explanation.

roadmap.title: Making deeper networks trainable
roadmap.text: ResNet uses additive shortcut connections to improve optimization in deep networks. The resulting features can also support tasks beyond classification.

roadmap.title: A separate task: recognition plus location
roadmap.text: YOLO predicts boxes and classes from the full image in a unified prediction problem. Detection is a different task, not a replacement for classification.

roadmap.title: Images as sequences of patches
roadmap.text: ViT feeds image patches into a Transformer and studies the effect of large-scale pretraining. Convolution and attention offer design choices with different data and compute tradeoffs.

terms.text: A small filter moves across an image, reusing its parameters at different positions. Stacked layers combine local patterns into more complex features.
Intermediate numbers that retain information useful for a task. They can feed a classifier or support detection and retrieval.
A patch is a small image region. Attention uses the input to determine how much information patches exchange. A patch need not correspond to an object.

IoU measures overlap between predicted and reference boxes. mAP summarizes precision–recall performance across classes; its overlap thresholds and evaluation protocol must match when comparing scores.

checklist: Run MNIST prediction and arrange at least 10 mistakes with their true and predicted labels. Describe the most common confusion.
Run YOLO on your own photos and save the annotated outputs. Find a missed object, a false detection, and an inaccurate box.
Keep the model fixed and add occlusion or change brightness on the same image set. Save the images alongside the changed predictions.
en.paperIntro: Use AlexNet and ResNet to understand feature learning and training, then choose YOLO or ViT. Follow each paper's inputs, outputs, and experiments.

papers.title: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks

zh.question: 能否让网络从大量图片里学出识别物体的特征？
zh.idea: 用多层卷积从像素逐层提取特征，配合 GPU 训练、ReLU 和抑制过拟合的办法。
zh.why: 它适合用来认识数据规模、计算和训练方法怎样共同促成进展。
zh.read: 先看网络结构与训练做法，再看分类结果和错误示例。
zh.limit: 研究重点是预设类别的图像分类，不能直接回答物体在哪里。

en.question: Can a network learn recognition features from a large image collection?
en.idea: Stack convolutional layers and combine GPU training with ReLU activations and regularization.
en.why: It connects advances in data, compute, and training practice.
en.read: Start with the architecture and training choices, then inspect classification results and errors.
en.limit: It classifies predefined categories; it does not directly locate objects.

papers.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition

zh.question: 为什么网络加深之后，连训练集也可能学得更差？
zh.idea: 让一组层学习相对输入的改变量 F(x)，再把输入加回去，得到 x + F(x)。
zh.why: 一个容易画清楚的结构变化，配合普通网络与残差网络的对照实验。
zh.read: 先看退化问题和残差模块，再比较不同深度的训练误差。
zh.limit: 残差连接改善优化，不保证任意加深都会更准；数据与计算成本仍然重要。

en.question: Why can a deeper network fit even its training data worse?
en.idea: Learn a change F(x) and add the input back, producing x + F(x).
en.why: A clear architectural idea is tested against plain networks at different depths.
en.read: Read the degradation problem and residual block, then compare training errors.
en.limit: Easier optimization does not make arbitrary depth beneficial; data and compute still matter.

papers.title: You Only Look Once: Unified, Real-Time Object Detection

zh.question: 怎样在一次网络前向计算中同时预测物体类别和位置？
zh.idea: 从整张图直接预测一组框及相应分数，把识别和定位放进同一个训练目标。
zh.why: 和入门检测 demo 能对上：看得到框，也能分析漏检、误检和速度。
zh.read: 先看检测流程和网格预测方式，再看定位误差的分析。
zh.limit: 原版在小物体、密集物体和精确定位上有明显局限；今天名为 YOLO 的工具已有许多结构变化。

en.question: Can one network pass predict both object categories and locations?
en.idea: Predict boxes and scores from the full image, training recognition and localization together.
en.why: It connects directly to a detection demo and its misses, false positives, and runtime.
en.read: Start with the detection pipeline and grid formulation, then localization errors.
en.limit: The original struggles with small or crowded objects and precise localization. Modern YOLO tools have changed substantially.

papers.title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale

zh.question: 图像分类是否必须依赖卷积这种局部结构？
zh.idea: 把图像切成小块，转换成向量，再用 Transformer 在块之间交换信息。
zh.why: 它把视觉与语言中的序列处理联系起来，也强调预训练数据规模的作用。
zh.read: 先看图像块如何进入网络，再看不同预训练规模的比较。
zh.limit: 原论文的强结果依赖大规模预训练，不能据此认为小数据上 Transformer 一定胜过 CNN。

en.question: Does image classification require convolutional structure?
en.idea: Turn image patches into vectors and exchange information using a Transformer.
en.why: It connects vision to sequence processing and highlights pretraining scale.
en.read: Follow patches into the model, then compare pretraining dataset sizes.
en.limit: The original strong results rely on large-scale pretraining; they do not imply Transformers always beat CNNs on small datasets.
